title: Low-Dose Aspirin for the Prevention of Preterm Delivery in Nulliparous Women With a Singleton Pregnancy (ASPIRIN): A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-Controlled Trial

sections.abstract: <jats:p>(Abstracted from <jats:italic toggle="yes">Lancet</jats:italic> 2020;395:285–293)</jats:p> <jats:p>Preterm birth, or delivery before 37 weeks, is one of the most common causes of infant mortality. New evidence has shown that women who take low-dose aspirin (81 mg) may be at lower risk of preeclampsia.</jats:p>
